policy.notes: Some providers publish their free tier on a web catalog their API does not expose. That page is legitimate PRICING evidence and nothing more: it cannot show that a model answers, and it goes stale without warning. A model listed here is admitted only when the live API also lists it, a completion probe passes, and the account holder attests the account is on that free tier. Each admission records which half of the evidence came from where.
policy.resolution: each display name must resolve to exactly one live API id; ambiguous or unmatched names are reported, never guessed
